ratings_why.fun: Every turn asks what fills the ground between three stations, heirs wake mid-fight, and Einsiedel with Dame Reisig is a real high roll; mid-game shops full of Knights you can't field hold it under 8.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7 because the tribe rule turns the zigzag board itself into the constraint (exactly F1, B2, F4) and makes other tribes' units the fuel, which no current tribe or generic auto-battler tribe does.

verdict_why: Nothing is broken or unreadable; what's left are watch items and ideas the owner can tune while balancing.

points.text: 15 of 19 cards are Knights but only three work at once, so mid-game shops often show Knights you can't use. One more Tier 2 or 3 Watcher would steady the middle turns.
Bare Ridge wins with one or two survivors and bleeds little hero damage. Sir Einsiedel could deal extra hero damage when he wins alone, so the few-giants plan pays off on the ladder.
Pennon-Bearer's "or" reads like a choice. "Each other Knight gets +1/+1, or +2/+2 if it is next to one of this unit's Gallery units" says it plainly.
Four Heather Hens around Herald of the Old Lek give 8 gold a turn on normal copies; a per-turn gold cap from Hens would keep the fun without the tempo spike.

Grand Master Ottokar pulls the late game toward a crowd of Knights, the opposite of the seed's lone champion. Fine as one high roll, but a second capstone that rewards keeping the lek would balance the two late plans.

standouts.why: Sir Einsiedel makes empty ground a real choice, and his x4 with Dame Reisig is the tribe's best moment.
Roost-Pine Squire turns the elder's death into permanent growth, so losing a unit in a fight feels like progress.
Dame Reisig judges and leaves, a clean finisher that also opens space for the open-ground cards.

weakest.why: Bristlebeard only moves Attack from the Gallery to himself, so the board gets no bigger overall.
Sprucehold Envoy is all geometry and no growth; it adds a station but is hard to read on the zigzag board.
Squire Konrad needs a Knight next to him to die, which at Tier 1 rarely happens, so the seed grows slowly.

flags.note: Heather Hen gold doubled by Herald of the Old Lek, and more with goldens, can snowball rolls and triples.
Golden Roost-Pine Squire with golden Chronicler gains three times a big elder's stats every fight the elder dies.
Golden Grand Master Ottokar puts every Knight on Station; watch whether breaking the lek becomes the only late plan.
